app.title: Medicine Brand Finder
app.tagline: Find the brand names of a medicine's active ingredient in other countries, from official medicines databases, open references and, optionally, AI.
disclaimer.title: Not medical advice.
disclaimer.text: A demo that collects names from public databases and, optionally, AI. Results can be incomplete or wrong. Always check the official product information and ask a doctor or pharmacist.
search.label: Active ingredient or brand name
search.placeholder: Ingredient or brand, e.g. ibuprofen, Nurofen, amoxicillin
search.coverage: Official databases in {n} countries{eu} • open references • optional AI
search.coverageNone: Official databases • open references • optional AI
search.needTerm.title: Search term required
search.needTerm.text: Enter an active ingredient or a brand name, for example ibuprofen or Nurofen.
search.failed.title: Search failed
search.none.title: No results found
search.none.toast: Nothing found for "{term}". Check the spelling or use the active ingredient.
country.label: Country
country.others: Other countries (open references and AI only)
progress.title: Searching sources ({done}/{total})
progress.waking: Waking the search server; the first search after a pause takes 10 to 20 seconds…
results.loading: Searching official databases, open references and AI providers…
ready.title: Ready to search
ready.p1: Type an active ingredient (for example {example}) or a brand name. You get the names it is sold under, country by country, from official medicines registers{coverage}, open references and, where the operator has set a key, AI suggestions.
ready.p2: Every result names its source and links to the record. Download any result as CSV, Excel, JSON or FHIR for your own tools.
ready.p3: Operators: add an AI key (OpenAI, Perplexity, DeepSeek or OpenRouter) in the {link} to get suggestions for countries without open data.
results.title: Results for "{term}"
results.linkCopied.title: Link copied
results.linkCopied.text: Anyone with the link sees this search.
results.linkFailed.title: Could not copy the link
results.linkFailed.text: Copy it from the address bar instead.
results.brand: {brand} is a brand name of {ingredient}. Showing the brands of {ingredient2} {where}.
results.brandOther: Careful: in {countries} the name {brand} is also used for {ingredient}. Check the active ingredient on the pack.
results.aiPending: Asking AI providers for more suggestions…
results.notReached: Not reached this time: {sources}. Results may be incomplete.
results.none.title: No results
results.none.text: Nothing found for "{term}". Check the spelling, or try the active ingredient as written on the pack (for example paracetamol).
note.noData: No data for {place} yet; showing results from all countries.
note.euWide: No national data for {place} yet; showing EU-wide authorisations (valid in {place}) and worldwide references.
note.region: No data for {place} yet; showing other countries in {region} and worldwide references. Brands differ by country.
note.nothing: No data for {place} or {region} yet; showing results from all countries. Brands differ by country.
card.aiWarning: Generated by a language model and not found in any database here; may be wrong. Check an official source.
card.curatedWarning: From a static list in this app, not from a regulator; may be out of date.
export.note: Each row names its source, the source's terms of use and any condition of reuse; keep them when you share the data. AI suggestions are marked as such; the FHIR file (for health-record systems) leaves them out and codes ingredients with RxNorm where it can.
export.termsMissing.title: Terms of use not loaded
export.termsMissing.text: The file says where to read them: the Data sources page.
export.failed.title: Download failed
export.failed.text: The file could not be made. Please try again.
sources.title: Data sources
sources.intro: Every result is labelled with the source it came from. Official databases are the reliable ones; open references are good but not complete; curated samples and AI suggestions must be checked.
sources.unreachable: The search server is not reachable from this page ({error}); only browser sources and curated lists will be used.
